status: PF-2 policy vectors (PeerFS read contract, section 2); every host implementation reproduces them
encoding: Each body is the exact UTF-8 text of a peerspan-policy-v2 policy statement body (the bytes body_base64 carries): compact JSON, keys in the contract's order. Positive bodies are accepted and serialize to exactly these bytes; negative bodies are refused as invalid.

positive.name: without_fs_rules
positive.note: A body without filesystem rules: byte-identical to a body before this contract.

positive.name: with_fs_rules
positive.note: Two hosts' rules, in ascending (host, space, branch) order; a UTF-8 branch name; principals ascending.

negative.name: unknown_key
negative.refused: a rule with an unknown key

negative.name: duplicate_key
negative.refused: a rule with a duplicate key

negative.name: host_not_id
negative.refused: host is not host_ and 64 lowercase hex

negative.name: host_short
negative.refused: host is not host_ and 64 lowercase hex

negative.name: space_not_id
negative.refused: space is not space_ and 32 lowercase hex

negative.name: space_upper
negative.refused: space is not space_ and 32 lowercase hex

negative.name: branch_long_utf8
negative.refused: branch is 256 bytes of UTF-8 (128 two-byte characters)

negative.name: principal_invalid
negative.refused: a principal of no known shape

negative.name: rules_unordered_branch
negative.refused: rules out of (host, space, branch) order

negative.name: rules_unordered_space
negative.refused: rules out of (host, space, branch) order

negative.name: rules_unordered_host
negative.refused: rules out of (host, space, branch) order

negative.name: rules_repeated
negative.refused: two rules for one (host, space, branch)
